Game Overview

In Spooky Blob, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a spooky adventure with Spooky Blob. Navigate through haunted landscapes, dodge sinister ghosts and scarecrows, and collect glowing hearts to unlock quirky characters. Master your reflexes with simple tap controls as challenges grow and dynamic environments keep you on edge in this thrilling arcade escapade.
